title: 我佇下跤 Guá Tī Ē-kha
subject: a couple at a Kaohsiung indoor climbing gym on a Saturday afternoon, her first time on a rope: he ties her figure-eight knot and checks it three times, belays her up the red route, and when her foot slips halfway and she hangs in midair hugging the wall he talks her into sitting back on the rope; then they swap, he falls and his extra thirty kilos yank her off the floor so they both hang there laughing, and on her last try she slaps the top hold and turns to find him still watching her from below
caption: Taiwanese Hokkien bachata in the classic 1990s Dominican guitar style. A requinto guitar picking bright, syncopated arpeggios and short answering fills; a second guitar strumming muted chords; a punchy electric bass syncopating against the bongos; bongos playing the martillo pattern, with a scraping güira that opens up on the choruses. Bright, dry, band-in-a-room mix with the requinto and the voice up front. A smooth high male tenor, sweet and slightly breathy, with short melismatic tails at line ends. 134 BPM, D major. Tender, playful and quietly devoted. No drum kit, no reggaeton dembow, no trap hi-hats, no autotune, no salsa horns, no pop-ballad strings.
lyrics:
[Verse]
禮拜六下晡 高雄的攀岩館
日頭 對天窗 斜斜照落來
我共你的索仔 拍一个八字結
看兩擺 閣看第三擺

[Pre-Chorus]
你攑頭 看紅色彼條路線
兩手抹白粉 猶原皮皮掣

[Chorus]
你蹈 我佇下跤
索仔 佇我手內
若驚 你就放手
我會共你掠牢牢

[Verse]
蹈到一半 你的跤 煞滑去
索仔一下絚 你吊佇半空中
我講 免驚 坐落來 索仔有我咧
你兩手 猶原攬牢彼堵壁

[Pre-Chorus]
你喝講 緊共我放落來
我講 歇一睏 左跤邊有一粒通踏

[Chorus]
你蹈 我佇下跤
索仔 佇我手內
手若酸 就坐落來歇
我會共你掠牢牢

[Verse]
換你顧索仔 換我來蹈
我比你 重三十公斤
我一下跋落來 你煞予我搝起來
咱兩个 攏吊咧 笑甲喘袂過來

[Bridge]
你講 閣一擺 這擺我欲蹈到頂
頂懸彼粒紅的 你伸手拍一下
越頭揣我 我猶咧看你

[Chorus]
你蹈 我佇下跤
索仔 佇我手內
你欲蹈偌懸 攏免驚
後擺 嘛是我佇下跤

[Outro]
慢慢仔落來 我佇遮
